comment: Gold entities for german-transcript.txt. Same conventions as michael-kende-gold.json: lowercased, surrounding punctuation removed, leading article and title removed; an entity mentioned n times is listed n times. 'ignore' holds borderline mentions that are neither credited nor counted as false positives. The person names in this transcript are pseudonyms: the real speakers were replaced word for word, so name lengths, titles and the bare first-name address are preserved. The spurious comma in 'Dr. Jens, Radtke' comes from the ASR and was kept, so that mention still tests whether a span survives punctuation inside a name.
ignore: lehrstuhl für neue und neueste geschichte
